If you paste the 2027 rate here or tell me where it was posted, I'll use that.

2. **Your sign-off doesn't cover sending a rate to Pree.** Rates count as finance figures. They can only go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark or the account's owner. Pree is on the Central team, and nothing I can see says she owns Thornbury. That means the mail needs Anselm's or June's approval, not yours as an account manager. If Pree does own Thornbury, tell me where that's recorded and I can go ahead without the extra step.

Once I have the rate, I'll write the draft (internal only, to psundaram@pemberline.com) and ask June or Anselm to approve it. Nothing goes to Pree until one of them says yes.
